preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence a must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the minimum number of changes required.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: The second line of output must contain a valid sequence of n integers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: any(int(x) == i + 1 for i, x in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()))
postconditions.description: The output sequence must have at least one element that is its own index, indicating a valid root.
